title: SecretScannerScanResult
description: Standard output contract produced by SecretScanner-K8s in Go and consumed by report generators and integrations.

schema_version.description: Semantic schema version of the output structure.

files_scanned.description: Total number of YAML documents or files inspected.

findings.description: Total count of deduplicated secret findings.

errors.description: Total count of recoverable file/syntax scan errors.

critical.description: Count of findings with Critical severity.

high.description: Count of findings with High severity.

medium.description: Count of findings with Medium severity.

low.description: Count of findings with Low severity.

findings.description: List of detected secrets. Each finding strictly contains only masked values.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier of the matching rule.

severity.description: Severity rating assigned to the finding.

file.description: Normalized slash-separated file path or source name.

line.description: Line number where the secret scalar resides.

column.description: Column number where the secret scalar resides.

field_path.description: Structural path to the YAML node (e.g. data.password, spec.template.spec.containers[0].env[0].value).

resource.description: Name of the Kubernetes resource from metadata.name.

kind.description: Kind of the Kubernetes resource (e.g. Deployment, Secret, ConfigMap).

match.description: Masked representation of the secret value. Raw secret strings are never emitted.

errors.description: List of per-file recoverable scan warnings and syntax errors.

file.description: Normalized path of the problematic file.

message.description: Sanitized error description without sensitive payload data.
